notes:
- Subscribe shows the real plans again. That window had been saying "No plans available" on every
  computer since March. It now asks the server each time it opens, so the plans and prices in front of
  you are the current ones and never a remembered copy — and it opens straight away, filling the list in
  as the answer arrives instead of making you wait for it first.
- Updates no longer leave anything behind. Every update so far kept its download and its unpacked files
  on your computer, tens of megabytes at a time, with nothing ever clearing them up. They are cleaned up
  from now on.
- A server that is busy for a moment no longer becomes an error. It used to be asked three times inside
  the same instant and then given up on, which is what was behind the occasional red "the asset manifest
  is unavailable" box. The add-in now waits a moment and asks again — and waiting no longer makes it
  report itself offline while it does.
- A button no longer refuses to work for hours after the computer's clock moves backwards. An automatic
  time correction or the end of daylight saving was enough to cause it.
